SELECT * FROM imp_eng_installation WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND project_id = #{query.projectId} AND deleted = 0 AND effective_to IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC FOR UPDATE

SELECT equipment_id, install_location FROM imp_eng_installation WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND project_id = #{query.projectId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 2 AND effective_from IS NOT NULL AND effective_to IS NULL
AND equipment_id IN #{id}
AND 1 = 0
ORDER BY effective_from DESC, id DESC
